findings.finding: A complete scorer-metric bundle could be misread as a counted-coordinate or waterfill-ready bundle.
findings.correction: Added a post-require_complete admission gate that requires receiver_object_builder, realized_uint8_quantum, candidate_delta, dimension_rate_home, and coder_payload_owner on a single occupied row; otherwise it emits the scoped PF3 blocker and zero rungs.

findings.finding: Floating-point cosine readback could exceed the mathematical interval by rounding.
findings.correction: Clamped only the derived cosine scalar to [-1,1]; source vectors and measured norms remain unchanged.

findings.finding: A raw/best-coded equality replay on an existing endpoint could be mistaken for a new coder race.
findings.correction: Typed both endpoint rows as settled control replays, coder_race_performed=false, and admitted only exact receiver-closure statuses.

findings.finding: Complete metric-bundle context was initially labeled as 162 measured RD1 cells despite the absence of any same-object rung delta.
findings.correction: Separated 162/162 cells with complete metric context from 0/162 measured rung deltas and 0/162 measured byte duals; all 162 prices remain explicitly NULL.

findings.finding: Direct composite-R wording could imply synthetic receiver-coordinate secants.
findings.correction: Scoped the coordinate domain to POST_R_PENULTIMATE_HEAD_QUOTIENT, required exact solved-plane R roundtrip, and typed secants NOT_APPLICABLE_DIRECT_SCORER_INTRINSIC_NO_ACTUATOR.

findings.finding: Initial 2 GiB and 3 GiB local memory caps were below actual deterministic scorer RSS.
findings.correction: Both attempts failed closed with checkpoints preserved; the resumable 4 GiB run completed at 3,563 MiB peak RSS.

findings.finding: Two generated direct-custody fields and the first checkpoint identity captured the transient isolated-worktree prefix.
findings.correction: Repository artifacts now serialize repository-relative paths; legacy checkpoint resume normalizes only an absolute path ending in the exact repository-relative config path while requiring every SHA and other identity field to match.
